Title: Tom: Preventing Damage outside of combat

Messages.Author: Gary K. Schwartz
Messages.Body:
I've seen the rulings that say the damage from Rutor's Hand can be
prevented with anything that prevents damage in combat. Two questions:
1) Although I'm sure the answer is yes, can you use Skin of Night
(inferior)
to change it to regular damage?
2) Does this ruling apply of other effects that cause (not
unpreventable)
damage outside of combat?

Gary S.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
schw...@math.uiuc.edu (Gary K. Schwartz) writes:

>I've seen the rulings that say the damage from Rutor's Hand can be
>prevented with anything that prevents damage in combat. Two questions:
>1) Although I'm sure the answer is yes, can you use Skin of Night
>(inferior)
> to change it to regular damage?

-----
From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Rutor's hand
Date: 8 Dec 1995 01:34:15 GMT
Message-ID: <4a84mn$6...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

When taking damage from superior Rutor's Hand, treat it as if you were
being struck in combat. So combat cards, Flak Jackets, etc. are effective.
-----

By the above errata, I'd say that Skin of Night can be used (in either
normal or superior mode) to offset the damage done by Rutor's Hand.

>2) Does this ruling apply of other effects that cause (not
>unpreventable)
> damage outside of combat?

In theory, probably. However, all other non-combat, damage-causing effects
from Jyhad have 'Damage Not Preventable' errata/reminder text in VtES.

Rutor's Hand is the only card of which I am aware that causes preventable
damage outside of combat.
